logic.description: Implemented as a monster natural permanent — never cast (creature innate, in_player_deck false). Natural: an enemy that ends an action in contact with the holder is afflicted; while it stands in contact with the holder its character target (Attack, Move, any cast) is forced to the holder (Rule 15 autotarget override, angerForcedTarget) and damage it would deal to anyone else is dropped. Lifted at its tower (entry hex) or with the last copy. Monster natural permanent (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_natural_permanents): a monster whose creature card has this innate effect starts with 2 copies already cast — one permanent id in permanents_csv plus a copy count in perm_copies_json, power 6 each (perm_power_json), both cards in its permanents holding (they count toward DECK_MIN), none in its deck, never cast (not in its deck, and destroyed copies are archived, so npcCastChoice never sees it). Rule 24 (a die of 6 of the stat of the effect's elements) destroys ONE copy per success (dropPermanent decrements, the destroyed copy's card goes to the monster's ARCHIVE — out of circulation); the effect lasts until both are gone. Wild monsters only (no companion / summon / human or npc_b hero); a restart / rejoin boots with exactly 2 again.

prerequisites.description: Held only by a wild monster whose creature card has this innate effect (no companion / summon / hero).
The enemy is in contact with the holder.

effects.description: Damage the target may deal to anyone but the caster while the permanent stands.
Natural: an afflicted enemy in contact deals no damage to anyone but the holder.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys ONE copy when it is at least 6.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_fire (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The effect stays flagged creature_innate (it is dealt to the awakened creature per Rule 3; a vote may still change in_player_deck).
The natural_permanent block (copies, power, semantics) stays.
